edges: Yates and Longley noted that Capel Lligwy was built in the large parish of Penrhos Lligwy.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Capel Lligwy is located near Rhos Lligwy in Anglesey.
The vault of Capel Lligwy was used to record atmospheres for an album by The Serpents.
Capel Lligwy was used as a private place of worship for Lligwy House.
Capel Lligwy has national recognition and statutory protection from alteration by Cadw.
The Pierce Lloyd family members were buried in the vault beneath the south chapel of Capel Lligwy.
Angharad Llwyd mentioned Capel Lligwy in her history of Anglesey.
Capel Lligwy was built to serve the expanding population in the large parish of Penrhos Lligwy.
